services.desc: We are a bay and inshore charter fishing business serving Destin, San Destin and 30A. We have the finest crew and equipment in the business and spare no expense to put you on the bite. Whether you are a family looking for a fun day on the water or a seasoned angler looking to improve your skills, Shallow Minded Fishing Charters can take care of you. We have three experienced captains who have combined 35 years experience on these waters. We also have two of the nicest inshore charter boats in the business to guarantee your day on the water is one you’ll never forget.
